GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down well back 10 lengths. well back turn hooking very wide. battled away # Not Sighted
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin and knuckled shortly after the start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 8 lengths. well back turn under pressure 6 lengths. weakened # Not Sighted
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Got its head up and overreacted when steadied near the 1500m. Raced wide and without cover until the 800m. Had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped soundly. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Stayed same until improving Four Wide from 600m & pushed to quicken Five Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 300m & worked to challenge leaders @ 200m. Found the lead @ 100m & held them late. # Relished 2000m.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 10th Outside 9 Lengths within 5-6 Lengths x 600 clear run home Hard Ridden 400 Kept Trying but was # not quick enough
Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 8 lengths. looking for run turn 5 lengths. got to outside in Straight . ran on strongly # just did enough
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Brushed with another runner on numerous occasions over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. moved up 4 Wide turn 2 lengths. ran on strongly. found plenty late # too strong
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: Option to be ridden further forward if circumstances permit; settled midfield.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted well back 6 lengths. well back turn looking for run 5 lengths. held up early in Straight . ran on well when clear # not best luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was held up between runners from the 400m until the 200m when shifting to the outside of runner to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1.5L off, running on half off 200m, same passing 100m, kept on strong to the line just couldn't reel in winner form that point # box seat/good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly through the middle stages. Passing the 1400m was restrained and inconvenienced for numerous strides thereafter when the pace slackened. Bumped with a runner passing the 400m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 7-8l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on strong taking lead approaching 100m and drew clear # back/ran on strong
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider pleaded guilty to a charge under AR132(5) after striking his mount on 9 occasions prior to the 100m and 19 times in totality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair drifted back 8l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off all clear, ran on strong down the outside making good ground, closest on line # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride 0.5kg over the allotted weight of 55.5kg.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 3 Wide early 2 lengths. under pressure turn 3 lengths. weakened # covered ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover until passing the 800m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok to lead 1 length clear, pushed along turn, joint lead Straightening Up same 200m, headed passing 100m, kept on well, no match winner # found 1 better
